description: A solitary wave (H 0.12 m on 0.5 m) that breaks on a 1:20 slope onto a 0.1 m shelf, SFLOW non-hydrostatic (A 220 2) on a grid with one cell in y, breaking with persistence (A 246 1, A 248 1); 2 levels following the surface jump (G 20), a regrid every 4 steps: the fresh patch cells take the breaking flags of the old patch or of the parent.
